_readme: Hand corrections to room labels, applied by floorplan_extractor.py after it reads a DXF.
Keys are floor names (<code>-<level>). Each fix is one of:
{"find": {"text": ..., "layer": ...}, "move_to_room": "112"}  move a drawn label into that room, under its number
{"add": "Seawolf Marketplace", "at_room": "111"}                add a label into that room, under its number
"layer" in find is optional. A fix that matches nothing is reported in the log, so a re-drawn DXF can't drop it silently.
Labels are also the app's room search: a moved or added label is what "SU Subway" resolves to.

AS119-01.note: The DXF draws 'Subway' as title lettering outside the building (y=-200, walls end at y=-22). Subway is room 112.
Room 111 is the Seawolf Marketplace; the DXF has only its number.
